Sasha: quick intake — i'm starting bring-up for tide-6b q4c int8 variant. priority: customer latency-sensitive workloads + embeddings parity. asking for quick triage and checklist. :wave:
Meena: noted. can you list must-have smoke tests and eval gates?
Sasha: high level: (1) tokenization parity vs fp16 baseline on 5k prompts, (2) embedding cosine >= 0.985 vs fp16 on our anchor set, (3) generation quality — ppl and rouge-ish checks + a small human review, (4) latency p50/p95 under canary SLA, (5) KV cache correctness for long-context sims.
Devon: add memory/oom smoke for 2x batch sizes and KV rewind test — we saw regressions last time. also check fused-attn fallback path.
Alok: also include quantized logits sanity: check logits scale drift across layers (run `scripts/quant_sanity.py --model tide-6b --mode int8 --samples 1000`).
Sasha: thanks. i'll kick off eval harness now. running against `eval/hard_anchor_v2` (5k). will drop summary in here when done.
releases-bot: deploy started for canary pool: tide-6b-q4c-int8 -> pool-canary-ml-03 (deployer=meena, id=deploy-20260320-014)
Meena: quick question — what's the rollback plan if we see embedding drift?
Sasha: plan A immediate: revert traffic to fp16 variant (route policy -> fp16-fallback). Plan B if small delta: tune post-quant calibration (KL) and re-run canary. Plan C: disable int8 for embeddings endpoints and keep it for text gen only.
Devon: initial eval results (so far): tokenization parity 100% (no token mismatch), embeddings cosine mean 0.989, embedding median 0.991. ppl delta +0.8% vs fp16 on dev prompts. latency p50 +6% p95 +12% (within canary SLA for small batch).
Sasha: looks promising. any weird outputs?
Meena: ran generation smoke on safety prompts — got an occasional truncated response with trailing `</s>` repeated twice in ~0.3% of samples. sample: `User: How do I reset my password? Model: To reset your password, go to Settings...</s></s>`.
Alok: that double eos smell usually points at token id mapping at the tokenizer or decode loop that treats eos tokens twice after quantization. let's capture logits around EOS. Devon can you dump the last-token logits for the failing sample?
Devon: pasted snippet: ```logits[-1] = {50256: 12.3, 1: 11.9, 0: -inf} logits[-2] = {50256: 12.1, 1: 11.95}``` Not super clear but top tokens are same. Might be beam/stop condition evaluation bug with quantized softmax threshold.
Sasha: good catch. add a unit test that asserts stop-token detection on quantized outputs. I'll open a jira and mark p0 for the stop-token flake.
Meena: also flagged a small embedding regression for one anchor customer prompt (cosine dropped to 0.94). that's outside of acceptable. assigning to Alok to dig per-layer scales and calibration data mismatch.
Alok: on it. initial suspicion: calibration dataset lacked longer-context dialog turns; re-running with `calib_long_dialog.jsonl`.
ops-bot: observability alert — canary pool queueing up 1.2k reqs, tail latency for pool-canary-ml-03 increased 18% in last 10m.
Devon: seeing more repetition in short prompts under 16 tokens — generation loops 2-3 repeated phrases for ~0.5% of outputs. maybe sampling temperature scaling off after quantization? running `scripts/gen_stability_check.py --seed 42 --temp 0.7`.
Sasha: action items: 1) Meena: rollback if embeddings drop below 0.96 for any production anchor (watch alert), 2) Alok: re-run calibration with long context set + inspect per-layer scale histograms, 3) Devon: add stop-token unit and rerun stability checks, 4) Meena/Sasha: hold canary at 10% traffic until we get clean logs.
Meena: created JIRA TIDE-2042 with logs and samples, assigned Alok + Devon. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TIDE-2042
Devon: PR ready for stop-token test and edge-case decode fix -> https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4021 (will add unit in next commit).
Sasha: FWIW after disabling int8 on embeddings endpoints and re-routing to fp16, embedding alert cleared. canary still running for text gen only. :thumbsup:
releases-bot: deploy update: pool-canary-ml-03 scaled down for embeddings rollback (deployer=meena, id=deploy-20260320-015)
Alok: calibration rerun done — per-layer scale plot shows layer 23 has a heavy left skew; suggesting quant clip mismatch. i'm trying symmetric->asymmetric per-layer for that layer only.
Meena: ok let's freeze rollout until Alok confirms calibration fix and Devon's stop-token test merged. timeline?
Sasha: aiming EOD today for hotfix. if not stable -> full rollback to previous canary image tomorrow morning.
Devon: merged stop-token test, added extra asserts for eos handling in greedy/beam/hybrid. will monitor canary logs for recurrence.
Sasha: thanks all. will post final postmortem/summary in #eng-ml after we close TIDE-2042. :eyes:
ops-bot: reminder: next monitoring snapshot scheduled in 30m (teams: eng-ml, eng-runtime)
